title: Korah
sourceLines: -(Also spelled CORE and KORE in A. V.) -1. A son of Esau Ge 36:5,14,18
.Jealous of Moses, leads two-hundred and fifty princes in an insurrection, and is swallowed up in the earth Nu 16; 26:9,10; De 11:6; Ps 106:17; Jude 1:11
-4. Son of Kohath, and head of the family of sacred musicians among the Levites 1Ch 6:22
